interaction.model_response: Both mutations are caught by the new tests. Now a visual check of the toast and log overlay in a real terminal.

tool_executions.arguments: {"command":"which tmux && go build -o /tmp/claude-1000/twin-test . && S=/tmp/claude-1000/demo && rm -rf $S && mkdir -p $S/locked $S/real && touch $S/a.txt && ln -s real $S/link && chmod 000 $S/locked && tmux kill-session -t tw 2>/dev/null; tmux new-session -d -s tw -x 120 -y 24 -c $S /tmp/claude-1000/twin-test && sleep 0.7 && tmux send-keys -t tw Down Enter && sleep 0.5 && tmux capture-pane -pt tw && tmux send-keys -t tw M-c && sleep 0.3 && tmux send-keys -t tw M-l && sleep 0.4 && tmux capture-pane -pt tw; tmux kill-session -t tw; chmod 755 $S/locked","description":"Drive the app in tmux to capture toast and log"}
